headline: US Initial Jobless Claims Fall to 189,000 in Late October
summary: US new jobless claims dropped to 189,000 for the week ending October 31, coming in below market forecasts.
why: Weekly jobless claims are a key high-frequency indicator of labor market health and economic momentum in the United States.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Better-than-expected labor data strengthens economic sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lower-than-expected jobless claims indicate a resilient labor market, reducing immediate recession fears.
